name: iLO / iDRAC (Redfish)
description: Server remote management over iLO (HPE) and iDRAC (Dell) via the Redfish REST API: power on/off/restart, health & sensors (temperature, fans, power supplies, consumption), inventory (CPU/RAM/drives/NICs), read & clear event logs, one-time boot override, virtual media (mount ISO), firmware, identify LED, BMC reset and arbitrary Redfish calls (raw access). Open the remote console & native web UI directly or proxy it through the backend. Reachable from the backend or via a node on the management network. BMCs are added by IP/host and optionally linked to a client (an “External management” button in the actions, a marker in the topology).
author: BYTERA

settings.label: Proxy hostname for the native web UI / remote console
settings.help: Optional. Lets the backend proxy the iLO/iDRAC UI including the HTML5 console under its own hostname - only the backend has to reach the BMC (e.g. over the VPN). '*' is replaced by the connection ID; needs a wildcard DNS record and a wildcard TLS certificate on the RMM (same domain as the dashboard). Empty = the console opens directly in a new tab (the browser must reach the BMC).
